basic_info.description: 2323 Laguna Street is an eight-unit condominium building located directly across from Lafayette Park in prestigious Pacific Heights. The property is fully tenant occupied and generating excellent income. This rare bulk condominium sale offers multiple exit strategies for the new owner, including continued rental operation or individual unit sales. The building features a desirable unit mix of one and two-bedroom apartments, plus a spectacular top-floor penthouse spanning approximately 2,500 square feet with four bedrooms and three bathrooms.  The penthouse boasts high-end finishes, panoramic bay and city skyline views, and a private deck overlooking  Lafayette Park. The two-bedroom units are approximately 1,400 square feet while the one-bedroom units offer a generous 1,200 square feet. Most units enjoy stunning city and bay views. The property includes garage parking for 9 cars and has been professionally managed and impeccably maintained. A seismic retrofit was completed in 2018 and the roof was replaced in 2023. This trophy asset offers excellent in-place income, strong rental upside potential, and the flexibility to sell units individuallya rare combination in Pacific Heights.
